title: Demanding more than $50 a week and walking out
summary: The band, paid $50 a week, asks for a raise, is threatened with being unable to play anywhere, and skips the weekend.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: OK, so after a while--we went on with that. So I went and asked the man--said "look here, man. We done built your--built this business up. Now we want some more money." He was paying us like $50 a week. $50 a week. Working--working six nights a week. We was only off on Mondays. And you know, well, we were making it. You know, we--wasn't none of us--we didn't have no responsibility.
Only we just had to pay for our room rent. Our room rent didn't cost that much.
You know what I mean? Well, shit, man, working six nights a week and, you know, and $50 a week, I--we need some more money, you know.

So he kept hemming / and hawing and he tell me "well, you know, it was worth a lot." So I said, "well, look, man. If you don't give us no more money, we going-- we going to split." And I told him we was going to leave and he said, "well, look, if you leave here, where you going to play." That's what he asked me. I said, "I don't know. I think we can play anywhere." Because we could, man because a lot of clubs wanted us to play.
You know, on the beach. He said, "well I'll tell you something." He said, "if you don't play here, you're not going to play nowhere else."

I said---"Oh?" . So I said OK. So I go and I tell--I tell--I tell the guys what he told me. So we said well, fuck it, man. Lets play up until Friday, let's play up until Thursday and if we really show them what the fuck to do. And so Friday, we didn't even show. That's when--that's the weekend.
